# Catalog of the library (rtl/lib)

Generated by `tools/catalog.py` (`make catalog`): change the header comment of a module and
run it again. `make kb` checks that this file is up to date.

Every module, package and macro file of `rtl/lib`, in the tree of its directories: `what` is
the first sentence of its header comment, `versions` the behave/struct (or other) versions,
`path` where it is, `test` its test directory, `kb` the kb records that point into it. Read it
before adding a block: the block you need may exist under another name.

      versions: [behave]
      path: rtl/lib/ai/systolic_array/behave/ai_systolic_array.sv

      kind: package
      what: "AXI (AMBA AXI4 and AXI5) encodings, for the adapters between AXI and the library's channels"

      kb: [rtl/lib/block/atomic/design]

  line_code:
    Dec4b3b:
      what: "The 4b/3b half of the 8b/10b decoder (IEEE 802.3 clause 36): the 4-bit part fghj of a received code to the three bits y (HGF) whose code it is, for a data or a control code (k, which the 6-bit part decides), at the running disparity rd_in after the 6-bit part"
      versions: [behave]
      path: rtl/lib/block/line_code/dec_4b3b
      kb: [rtl/lib/block/line_code/dec_8b10b/design]
    Dec6b5b:
      what: "The 6b/5b half of the 8b/10b decoder (IEEE 802.3 clause 36): the 6-bit part abcdei of a received code to the five bits x (EDCBA) whose code it is, at either running disparity, and whether it is K.28's part"
      versions: [behave]
      path: rtl/lib/block/line_code/dec_6b5b
      kb: [rtl/lib/block/line_code/dec_8b10b/design]
    Dec8b10b:
      what: "8b/10b line code decoder (IEEE 802.3 clause 36; Widmer and Franaszek): a received 10-bit code, at the running disparity rd_in, to its byte D.x.y or control code K.x.y; combinational (the running disparity register is the user's: rd_in <= rd_out each code, starting at -1)"
      versions: [behave]
      path: rtl/lib/block/line_code/dec_8b10b
      test: test/block/line_code/dec_8b10b
      kb: [rtl/lib/block/line_code/dec_8b10b/design]
    Enc3b4b:
      what: "The 3b/4b half of the 8b/10b line code (IEEE 802.3 clause 36; Widmer and Franaszek): the high three bits y (HGF) of a byte D.x.y or K.x.y to the 4-bit part fghj of its code, at the running disparity after the 6-bit part (from Enc5b6b)"
      versions: [behave]
      path: rtl/lib/block/line_code/enc_3b4b
    Enc5b6b:
      what: "The 5b/6b half of the 8b/10b line code (IEEE 802.3 clause 36; Widmer and Franaszek): the low five bits x (EDCBA) of a byte D.x.y to the 6-bit part abcdei of its code, at the running disparity rd_in"
      versions: [behave]
      path: rtl/lib/block/line_code/enc_5b6b
      kb: [rtl/lib/block/line_code/enc_8b10b/design]
    Enc8b10b:
      what: "8b/10b line code encoder (IEEE 802.3 clause 36; Widmer and Franaszek): a byte D.x.y (x = data[4:0], y = data[7:5]) or a control code K.x.y to its 10-bit code, at the running disparity rd_in; combinational (the running disparity register is the user's: rd_in <= rd_out each symbol, starting at -1)"
      versions: [behave]
      path: rtl/lib/block/line_code/enc_8b10b
      test: test/block/line_code/enc_8b10b
      kb: [rtl/lib/block/line_code/enc_8b10b/design]
    LineCodePkg:
      kind: package
      what: "The tables of the 8b/10b line code (IEEE 802.3 clause 36; Widmer and Franaszek), shared by the encoder and decoder blocks of rtl/lib/block/line_code: one source, so they cannot disagree"
      path: rtl/lib/block/line_code/line_code_pkg.sv
      kb: [rtl/lib/block/line_code/dec_8b10b/design, rtl/lib/block/line_code/enc_8b10b/design]
